item.title: Seattle weather: Light dusting of snow on slopes tonight
item.description: On and off showers will be possible through the weekend and are forecast to wrap up early Monday. Spring-like weather is expected next week with near record highs nearing 60 degrees.

item.title: 'ICE Out Now' demonstrators move through Seattle on Saturday
item.description: Some Seattle roads are blocked to traffic as an 'ICE Out Now" protest moves through parts of the downtown area on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Thousands of fans fill T-Mobile Park for Seattle Mariners Fanfest
item.description: It's Fanfest time in Seattle! Families, residents and visitors came together to pack T-Mobile park to get on the field and celebrate. FOX 13 was there to chat about the season.

item.title: Sloppy weather at times in Seattle on Sunday
item.description: A front Sunday morning will trigger a period of widespread rain. Showers will turn more hit-or-miss by Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Gunfight kills 1, injures 3 in Seattle's 'Sinking Ship' garage
item.description: One person is dead and three others were hospitalized by a shootout in Seattle's famous "Sinking Ship" parking garage on Sunday.

item.title: Seattle Kraken takes victory in Las Vegas over Golden Knights
item.description: Kaapo Kakko scored the go-ahead goal in the third period and lifted the Seattle Kraken to victory over the Vegas Golden Knights.

item.title: FOX 13 Seattle announces 7-hour Super Bowl 2026 pregame show
item.description: FOX 13 Seattle will deliver seven straight hours of live pregame coverage on Super Bowl Sunday, featuring a massive roster of anchors and reporters live from Seattle and CA's Levi's Stadium.

item.title: Some Seattle schools delayed over shooting deaths of Rainier Beach teens
item.description: A handful of Seattle schools will be on adjusted schedules on Monday, following the shooting deaths of two teens in Rainier Beach on Friday.

item.title: Seattle weather: Wet and breezy end to the weekend
item.description: While Monday will bring another round of wet weather, drier, more spring-like weather is ahead later this week. Afternoon highs will be nearing records, close to 60 degrees.

item.title: Viral video: Son surprises Seattle Seahawks superfan dad with NFC championship tickets
item.description: A viral video shows a son travelling to Seattle to bring his Seahawks superfan dad surprise tickets to the NFC championship game, following a harrowing medical journey.
